messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall - spike of 5xx and timeouts observed from edge -> gateway in the last 2m. Alert group: gateway-5xx-spike. Rolling error rate: 18% on /v1/chat and /v1/generate.

alex_chang: I can pick this up. Confirming: errors started ~1825133900?

maria_rodriguez: Correct. Traces show a lot of 503/504s from envoy upstream selection failures and some 5xx from retries.

lee: Seeing a big increase in upstream_5xx and upstream_request_timeout counters on the envoy admin page. Trying envoy stats now: `curl -s http://localhost:19000/stats | egrep \"upstream_5xx|upstream_rq_\"`

samira: Quick customer check: ~12 distinct customers impacted, mostly heavy chat paths. Error budget alerts firing for some teams.

alex_chang: Reproducing locally against LB: `curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer x\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"test\"}'` -> immediate 503 intermittently.

nina: I pulled the latest envoy route config from the control plane. Notable: a recent patch (git rev abc123, rolled ~30m ago) added a route-level retry policy with `retry_on: 5xx, gateway-error` and `num_retries: 3` for the /v1/* prefix. That looks suspect.

alex_chang: If upstream is overloaded, route-level retries can amplify failures. We should remove retries ASAP and fallback to cluster-level behavior.

eng-lead: Can you confirm if circuit breaker (max_connections/max_pending) was also changed in that deploy?

maria_rodriguez: Yes — cluster circuit_breakers had lowered thresholds in same deploy (commit abc123). max_concurrent_requests set to 100 -> 40 for the gpu-backend cluster.

lee: So two factors: stricter CBs and aggressive route retries. That can cause connect failures and upstream saturation.

alex_chang: Proposed immediate mitigation (hotfix): revert the route retry policy OR set num_retries: 0, and restore circuit_breaker thresholds to previous values. I'll prepare the control-plane rollback.

oncall-bot: @alex_chang you are now on call for incident 1825134000.

alex_chang: Taking the handoff. Running a controlled revert against control plane: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/configs/revert -d '{\"commit\":\"abc123\"}'` (will target route config only).

samira: Heads-up to support: customer-facing impact started 2m ago, severity P1-ish for chat customers. Please stand by for status update.

maria_rodriguez: While that runs, I'm scaling gpu-backend deployment by +2 pods: `kubectl scale deploy gpu-backend --replicas=8 -n prod`. Also bumping cluster max connections temporarily.

lee: I've pulled envoy admin for the problematic host: `/clusters?format=json` shows `gpu-backend` at 80% saturated on a few hosts.

alex_chang: Revert job started. Patch to remove retry policy succeeded on control plane for service-edge route. Pushing to Envoy via xDS now.

nina: Watching metrics: within 20s of the xDS update we see a drop in retry counters. Upstream_5xx rate down to ~6% (was 18%).

eng-lead: Good. Any sign of error regression?

maria_rodriguez: After scaling and CB restore, latency back to baseline for majority of requests. Some hosts still flapping but overall SLA impact reduced.

samira: Support update: initial message sent to impacted customers, we're investigating and rolling mitigations.

lee: One more safety change: I'm pushing a temporary route filter to disable retries in envoy config for the /v1/* prefix as a belt-and-suspenders measure. Command: `kubectl apply -f disable-retries-routepatch.yaml`

alex_chang: Confirmed config push applied to all edge proxies. Observability shows 5xx down to 1.8% across the cluster in last 5m.

oncall-bot: Incident 1825134000 acknowledged. Auto-escalation timer paused.

nina: Root cause hypothesis summary: recent config deploy (abc123) simultaneously lowered cluster circuit breaker thresholds and enabled route-level retries for the chat/generate routes. The combination caused request amplification and upstream saturation leading to 5xx/timeouts.

eng-lead: Agreed. Immediate remediation: revert retry policy + restore CBs + scale. Medium-term: add deploy gating and pre-deploy canary for control-plane route changes.

maria_rodriguez: Action items:
- alex_chang: Postmortem draft and timeline (due EOD).
- eng-lead: Add a CI/eval to simulate retries x concurrency on route changes.
- nina: Add monitoring alert for simultaneous increase in retry and upstream_5xx metrics.
- lee: Create a runbook step for disabling retries and restoring CBs.

samira: Customer comms: we'll send an update in 30m with mitigation summary and ETA for full recovery confirmation.

alex_chang: Current status: mitigation applied, traffic healthy, continuing to monitor for 30m. If stable we'll close and start postmortem.

nina: Adding logs snippet for audit: 
```
[2026-03-14T01:00:12Z] control-plane apply: route /v1/* retry_on: 5xx,gateway-error num_retries:3 (commit abc123)
[2026-03-14T01:29:43Z] envoy upstream reset: connection failure -> upstream overflow
[2026-03-14T01:30:10Z] control-plane revert: removed route-level retries for /v1/* (commit revert-abc123)
```

lee: Note for postmortem: avoid changing retry policy and CBs in same deploy. We should require separate rollouts.

oncall-bot: Incident 1825134000: mitigated -> monitoring.

alex_chang: Closing notes: no data loss, customers experienced elevated errors for ~28 minutes, mitigated by rollback+scale. I'll kick off postmortem doc and link artifacts (xDS diffs, envoy stats, traffic heatmaps).

samira: Thanks all for the quick response. :thumbsup:

maria_rodriguez: Filing follow-ups in product backlog for gating and a canary harness for route changes.

eng-lead: End of thread.
